units.source_text: 回京时一路上逍遥游览，但心中念念不忘明石姬。

en.t: On the journey back to the capital, he traveled at leisure and enjoyed the sights along the way, but in his heart he could not stop thinking of the lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 地方上的妓女都集拢来逢迎。

en.t: The local courtesans all gathered around to flatter and welcome him.

units.source_text: 那些虽为公卿而年轻好事之人，对这些妓女颇感兴趣。

en.t: The younger nobles and courtiers, curious and fond of diversion though they were men of rank, took considerable interest in these women.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子想道：“风月之事，情感之发，

en.t: But Prince Genji thought, “In affairs of romance and refinement, when feeling is stirred,

units.source_text: 亦须对方人品可敬可爱，方有意趣。

en.t: there is charm only when the other person’s character is worthy of respect and affection.

units.source_text: 即使逢场作戏，倘对方略有轻薄之态，也就失却牵惹心目的价值了。”

en.t: Even in a passing amusement, if the other person shows the slightest trace of frivolity, she loses the power to attract the heart and eye.”

units.source_text: 因此那些妓女人人装模作样，撒娇撒痴，

en.t: For that reason, when all those courtesans put on airs, acted coy, and played the fool,

units.source_text: 而源氏公子只觉得讨厌。

en.t: Prince Genji found them only distasteful.
